PMAT, Inc. develops mission-critical digital capabilities across cloud, data, and software environments for defense and warfighter missions. The Junior Software Engineer will support the Ship Self-Defense System by testing and maintaining legacy software, troubleshooting operational issues, developing new combat system software, and documenting solutions.
Information Technology
Software
Growth Opportunities
No H1B
Security Clearance Required
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
The Software Engineer, under the direction of a lead engineer(s), will support the program by performing a variety of duties, including testing, test procedure creation, and maintaining software environments and other duties as assigned
Test, analyze, and fix legacy SSDS software trouble reports
Review Specification Change Notices (SCNs) for new SSDS software for accuracy in reflecting interface requirements, compatibility with existing architecture and requirements, and clarity
Develop new combat system software based on requirements and participate in code reviews
Document and demonstrate solutions via text, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments, and clear code
Work collaboratively with others to achieve goals, be a persistent, creative problem ­solver, and stay on the leading edge of development practices
